summary: Nine registered storage provider profile classes, each a mountainash_settings Profile whose fields are generated from a module-level StorageProfileSpec and registered in STORAGE_REGISTRY via @register. Four providers have a storage backend today: local (LocalStorageProfile), s3 (S3StorageProfile, covering the aws/express/r2/minio/b2 flavors), sftp (SFTPStorageProfile) and http (HTTPStorageProfile). Five are settings-only with implemented=False and no registered backend, so constructing a facade for them raises BackendNotImplementedError: gcs (GCSStorageProfile), azure_storage (AzureStorageProfile, blob/files), ftp (FTPStorageProfile, FTP/FTPS), smb (SMBStorageProfile) and github_repo (GitHubRepoStorageProfile, read-only). Profiles emit SDK config only. Credentials come from auth-client auth profiles at connection time.
key_classes: S3StorageProfile (registry key 's3') — BACKEND: S3StorageBackend registered for S3, S3EXPRESS, R2, MINIO, B2. FLAVOR in {aws, express, r2, minio, b2} selects endpoint/addressing; emits boto3 client kwargs + botocore Config via the TargetFamily.BOTO adapter; default_auth IAM, supported {IAM, NONE}; RANGE_* fields for random reads
LocalStorageProfile (key 'local') — BACKEND: LocalStorageBackend. ROOT_PATH confines every facade path, CREATE_PATH creates it; stdlib only; auth NONE only

SFTPStorageProfile (key 'sftp') — BACKEND: SFTPStorageBackend. HOST/USERNAME required, PORT 22, paramiko connect kwargs via TargetFamily.PARAMIKO adapter plus a _post_connect envelope (KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE, HOST_KEY_POLICY reject|warn|auto_add, default reject); auth PASSWORD default, also CERTIFICATE, KERBEROS, NONE; RANGE_* fields

HTTPStorageProfile (key 'http') — BACKEND: HTTPStorageBackend for http:// and https://. Timeouts, redirects, VERIFY_SSL, HEADERS emitted as httpx.Client kwargs via TargetFamily.HTTP; auth NONE default, also TOKEN, PASSWORD, OAUTH2; RANGE_* fields

GCSStorageProfile (key 'gcs') — SETTINGS-ONLY (implemented=False). PROJECT, BUCKET_NAME, API_ENDPOINT, LOCATION, USER_PROJECT; sdk google-cloud-storage; auth SERVICE_ACCOUNT default, also IAM, OAUTH2, TOKEN, NONE

AzureStorageProfile (key 'azure_storage') — SETTINGS-ONLY (implemented=False). SERVICE_TYPE in {blob, files}; ACCOUNT_NAME, CONTAINER_OR_SHARE, ACCOUNT_URL/ENDPOINT_SUFFIX, TOKEN_INTENT, API_VERSION, MAX_BLOCK_SIZE; provider_type AZURE_BLOB; auth AZURE_AD default, also TOKEN, PASSWORD, NONE

FTPStorageProfile (key 'ftp') — SETTINGS-ONLY (implemented=False). USE_TLS selects ftplib.FTP vs FTP_TLS; to_handler_kwargs returns an envelope {ftp_class_path, init_kwargs, _connect_kwargs, _post_connect}; auth PASSWORD default, also NONE
SMBStorageProfile (key 'smb') — SETTINGS-ONLY (implemented=False). SERVER, PORT, USERNAME, DOMAIN, ENCRYPT, CONNECTION_TIMEOUT; sdk smbprotocol; auth PASSWORD or KERBEROS (no NONE)

GitHubRepoStorageProfile (key 'github_repo') — SETTINGS-ONLY (implemented=False), read_only=True. ORG, REPO, REF (emitted as sha), BASE_URL, TIMEOUT for fsspec GithubFileSystem; auth TOKEN default, also JWT, NONE
key_functions: validate_flavor(v) — validates the S3 FLAVOR discriminator
validate_service_type(v) — validates the Azure SERVICE_TYPE discriminator
<Profile>.to_handler_kwargs() — SDK-ready kwargs without credentials (a deprecated shim delegating to emit(TargetFamily) on S3/SFTP/HTTP; hand-written on the others)
extension_points: Add a provider: define a StorageProfileSpec (parameters, provider_type, supported_auth, implemented), a Profile subclass with __spec__ and TYPE_CHECKING field declarations, decorate with @register, and import it in profiles/__init__.py
Per-target emission: set __adapters__ = {TargetFamily.X: fn(profile, merged_kwargs)} and _sdk_family() so create_connection can emit(family)
ParameterSpec(driver_key=...) maps a field straight into SDK kwargs; validator= attaches field validation
Flipping implemented=True must be paired with a register_storage_backend registration for spec.provider_type (drift test)
lifecycle_notes: Package import requires [http]; an ImportError is converted to MissingExtraError naming [http]
Importing settings.storage.registry imports this package at the bottom to populate STORAGE_REGISTRY; the profile modules in turn import register from the registry (intentional import cycle)
Profiles never hold credentials; create_connection layers auth_profile.emit(family, base=...) over profile.emit(family)
S3 flavor endpoint errors (minio without ENDPOINT_URL, r2 without ACCOUNT_ID/ENDPOINT_URL) are raised at emit time, not at profile construction
RANGE_CACHE/RANGE_BLOCK_SIZE/RANGE_MAX_BLOCKS on S3/HTTP/SFTP are transport settings read by RangePolicy, not SDK kwargs
documentation_hooks: Provider profile reference: one page per profile with field table (generated from __spec__.parameters), auth modes, emitted kwargs
Support matrix: providers with a backend (local, s3 family, sftp, http) vs settings-only (gcs, azure_storage, ftp, smb, github_repo)
S3 flavors guide: aws/express/r2/minio/b2 endpoint and addressing rules
SFTP host-key policy security guidance (reject vs warn vs auto_add)
Writing a new provider profile (contributor guide)
examples: examples/storage_profiles/example.py — builds aws and r2 S3StorageProfile instances and inspects emitted boto3 kwargs and supported auth modes
examples/auth_compatibility/example.py — pairs S3StorageProfile with auth profiles and shows UnsupportedAuthProfileError for rejected modes
risks: profiles/__init__.py docstring is stale: it names S3Settings, AzureStorageSettings, GCSSettings, FTPSettings, SMBSettings, LocalSettings, GitHubRepoSettings, HTTPSettings instead of the actual *StorageProfile classes

Several module/class docstrings cite mountainash_transport.settings.adapters.<provider>.build_handler_kwargs, but no settings/adapters package exists; settings-only profiles also keep commented-out _adapter stubs

AGENTS.md profile table names 'GitHubStorageProfile'; the real class is GitHubRepoStorageProfile with registry key 'github_repo' (Azure's key is 'azure_storage'), which matters for resolve_storage provider: values
SFTPStorageProfile.get_connection_url and FTPStorageProfile.get_connection_url read a ROOT_PATH attribute that neither spec defines, so that branch is dead
to_handler_kwargs is labelled a 'Deprecated shim' on S3/SFTP/HTTP yet is the ProfileProtocol contract method and is called in the storage_profiles example
Settings-only profiles validate and resolve successfully through resolve_storage; failure only surfaces later as BackendNotImplementedError when a facade/backend is requested
open_questions: Is to_handler_kwargs actually deprecated (per the S3/SFTP/HTTP docstrings) given ProfileProtocol requires it and the user-facing example calls it? If so, what replaces it in the protocol?
Should settings-only profiles (implemented=False) be documented as public user surface now, or flagged as preview until backends land?
